name: Nobunaga Oda
source:
"Sounds like you just don't want to admit the truth to yourself."

The leader of the Oda Clan. A ruthless and violent warlord who is trying to take over the world. He fears the powers of the "ninja", and has ordered his son, Nobukatsu, to "wipe out all ninjas"

[from [url=https://shall-we-date.fandom.com/wiki/Nobunaga_Oda]Fandom Wiki]
